differences.native: MySQL uses a RANGE window with INTERVAL 2 DAY PRECEDING and retains windows containing three rows.
differences.app: SQLite averages the current and two preceding rows, then uses LAG plus julianday subtraction to require a two-day span.
differences.rationale: SQLite does not support a date INTERVAL in a RANGE frame. Because (user_id, steps_date) is unique, three ordered rows spanning exactly two days are exactly three consecutive calendar dates. Both queries partition and order identically, compute the same average, round to two decimals, and emit the same ordered columns.
